title: Ben J NDE 4737/21730/22088 NDE 22088
content:
4737 I had two heart attacks in 2007. The first attack was in January when they put in two stents. Then I had another heart attack in December of 2007. That's when I had the out of body experience when I was on the operating table. I watched them take off my socks and my pants. Then I saw my wife (she has gray hair now) but when I saw her, she had black hair like she had when we met. Then I saw the white light. It was the brightest light I ever saw.
